description: GET a URL and read the page. HTML returns as Markdown (links kept, scripts dropped); `raw: true` for the body as sent. For POST or custom headers use `http_request`.
name: web_fetch

max_bytes.description: Cap the returned text at this many bytes (default 1_000_000). Bounds the OUTPUT — the extracted markdown, or the raw body with raw:true — never the markup the extractor reads, so lowering it cannot cost you content the page actually had.
